issues.message: Headline is truncated mid-word: reads 'BUY ETFs COMM' instead of 'BUY ETFs COMMISSION FREE!'. Critical message ('COMMISSION FREE') is lost.
CTA label is clipped on the right: reads 'START INVEST' with the closing letters and parenthesis cut off by the canvas edge. No right-side padding.
MEXEM logo wordmark at the top is clipped by the top canvas edge — only the lower portion of the letters is visible.
Variant fails to preserve the headline's full copy and CTA label that are intact (though also clipped) in the source, indicating layout/scale was not adapted for 728x90.
Because the headline is truncated to 'BUY ETFs COMM', the visual reading order conveys no meaningful value proposition before the CTA, weakening hierarchy.

notes: Variant is unshippable: headline, CTA, and logo are all clipped at the 728x90 frame. Brand colors and font choices remain on-brand, but content integrity fails.
